name: Magic Mushroom
description: Magic Mushroom is a customizable benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems against heterogeneous retrieval noise. It includes 7,468 single-hop and 3,925 multi-hop question-answer pairs and allows flexible configuration of noise combinations to simulate real-world retrieval noise scenarios.
reputation: A relatively new but increasingly cited RAG robustness benchmark in the literature, especially for studying retrieval noise and multi-hop QA settings.
notes: Focuses on noise-robustness evaluation for RAG systems with configurable noise distributions.
